clips.title: The story
paras: Camping 101: Cooking introduces adventurers in Dun Morogh to the essential survival skill of cooking. Beyond preparing provisions, learning this trade enables travelers to light campfires that serve as the foundation for wilderness campsites.

For any traveler braving the wilds, establishing a reliable campsite begins with a flame. In Dun Morogh, novice adventurers are directed to Kharanos to learn the fundamentals of cooking under Gremlock Pilsnor. Cooking is not simply about sustaining oneself with hot meals on the road; a sturdy campfire serves as the literal and practical anchor for any outdoor camp.

A newly learned campfire allows an adventurer to pitch a humble camp anywhere in the open wilderness. While rudimentary fires support only minimal furnishings, improving one's cooking proficiency unlocks the ability to build larger blazes. Furthermore, artisans skilled in other crafting trades can fashion additional furnishings to transform a simple rest stop into a fully outfitted encampment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, priest. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
